_about: Facts for scoring, checked on the kit built from the original PDF (2306-NA_231114 - PC Submittal Set.pdf, 30 pages, structural sheets 24x36 in, rendered at 200 dpi). status: verified = read by a person at tile resolution on the kit images; disputed = a count that is not yet settled on a marked-up sheet and goes to the owner. Counts are never taken from a model, from two models agreeing, or from the app's saved reading.

facts.note: Printed. Absent from the app's v3 reading. Must be a row whether or not an instance is found.

facts.rule: 5'-0" MAX: 2-2x6 OR 4x6 (2x4 studs) / 3-2x6 OR 6x6 (2x6) / 4-2x6 OR 8x6 (2x8); 8'-0" MAX: 2-2x8 OR 4x8 / 3-2x8 OR 6x8 / 4-2x8 OR 8x8; OVER 8'-0": SEE PLAN. HEADER NOTED IN TABLE SHALL BE PROVIDED OVER ALL WINDOWS, DOORS, AND OTHER OPENING, UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
